interactions.summary: The host pushes once more on whether the old dream of moving west is still alive, and Jiang bluntly says it is and that he would not move east himself.
The host closes by asking where people should follow Jiang's work.
Jiang directs viewers to his YouTube channel as the best place to follow his work.
The host plugs Jiang's channel, both men sign off, and the host closes the video with a standard subscribe request.
interactions.speaker_attribution: Host David Lin and Jiang outro

claims.claim: Jiang affirms that the aspiration to move family and capital to America is, in his view, even stronger now than it was 20 or 30 years ago.
He implicitly rejects the popular advice to 'move east' by saying he personally would not do it.
Jiang says his YouTube channel is the primary place to follow his work.

signature_moments.moment: The closing soft-power claim lands with a blunt personal verdict: the old westward dream is even truer today, and Jiang would not move east himself.
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It gives the interview a memorable final sting and reinforces Jiang's claim that American attraction still dominates Chinese imagination.

chronology_notes.note: The interview closes on 2025-07-23 by turning the U.S.-China soft-power argument into a direct present-tense lifestyle judgment before the standard channel plug.
